rules.statement: Section 20(b) of the Bribery Act, when properly construed, allows for a wide interpretation of 'grant or benefit' to include soliciting and accepting money as an inducement for procuring any grant, lease or other benefit from the Government.
rules.supporting_quote: "Common sense therefore requires that in paragraph (vi) of section 20 the expression 'grant or benefit' must be widely construed. It was held that" the operative word in paragraph (vi) is the word 'benefit' and that its ordinary wide meaning is' not narrowed down by its association with the words 'grant' or 'lease' which precede it."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 20(a)(vi) of the Bribery Act, as cited in the judgment.

meta.parties: Wijeratne Bandara v. Director General Of Prevention Of Bribery And Corruption
